headline: IBM says an early Mashreq pilot cut integration design and troubleshooting time by up to 70%
body: IBM says Mashreq cut integration design and troubleshooting time by up to 70% in an early pilot of IBM Bob. The press release adds that tasks that took two to three hours of manual work now take minutes.
note: The 70% comes from an early pilot that IBM announced. A secure gateway handles about 4,000 AI-agent requests a month across Mashreq's banking, payments and enterprise systems.

evidence.text: In an early pilot of IBM Bob, Mashreq cut integration design and troubleshooting time by up to 70%, turning two- to three-hour tasks into minutes.

In an early pilot of IBM Bob, IBM’s AI software engineering platform, the Dubai-based bank cut the time spent on integration design and troubleshooting by up to 70%, according to a Monday (Oct. 12) announcement from IBM.
The press release added that tasks that took two to three hours of manual work now take minutes.
A secure gateway built on Model Context Protocol (MCP) handles about 4,000 AI-agent requests a month across Mashreq’s banking, payments and enterprise systems.
